about: Fingerprints (from installed.json) of Herdr's originals that your copies were made from (herdr-app 0.1.10): spaces -> mods/space-groups and layout:main -> layouts/minjie.json (2026-10-31), tabs -> mods/my-tabs (2026-10-31). When installed.json shows other values, Herdr changed an original: the copy may miss that change.
